welcome.label: Welcome · the speed limit sign

parts.label: 📌 The pier notice
parts.title: The Speed Limit Sign
rows: The pier needs a cart speed limit
A bumped cart may roll 2 feet at most

parts.label: ✉️ Three sealed envelopes
parts.title: Gus · Rosa · Sam
parts.body: Each one sealed a prediction. They open when the case is cracked.

welcome.script:
(Hold up a sealed envelope.) Inside this envelope is a prediction. I wrote it BEFORE the test, and I can’t change it now.

[ON SCREEN: The pier notice]
The pier manager wants a speed limit for golf carts. But Gus says speed doesn’t matter. He tried it once!

[ON SCREEN: Three sealed envelopes]
Gus, Rosa and Sam each sealed a prediction. Whose will the trials support? Press Listen on Sam’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · ghost marbles (Clue 1)

parts.label: 👻 Ghost marbles
parts.title: Predict, then play
rows: Drag the ghosts onto the board

warmup.script:
[ON SCREEN: A Newton’s cradle]
This toy is a Newton’s cradle. If I pull back TWO balls and let go, how many fly out the other side? Don’t tell me. Write it in the box first!

[ON SCREEN: Ghost marbles]
Now the ghost marbles. Your ghost is your prediction. Put it where you think the real marble will stop, then press Play. Press Listen.

part1.label: Part 1 · the I-knew-it trap (Clue 2)

parts.label: 📝 Before or after?
parts.title: The “I knew it!” trap
rows: Read the time on each note
BEFORE the test: can be checked

part1.script:
(Snap your fingers, then say proudly:) I KNEW I was going to snap!

[ON SCREEN: Before or after?]
Hmm. Does that count? Read each sticky note and look at its time. Which ones were written before the test? Press Listen.

part2.label: Part 2 · the flag lane (Clue 3)

parts.label: 📊 The gap meter
parts.title: One thing changes
parts.body: 3 trials on the low ramp, then 3 on the high ramp. Same marble, same block.

part2.script:
(Roll a ball across your desk, then roll it again.) Did it stop in the same place both times? Not exactly!

[ON SCREEN: The flag lane]
Plant your flag where you think the block will stop. Then roll. The tape shows your gap.

[ON SCREEN: The gap meter]
After three trials, change ONE thing: the ramp. Watch out for a surprise trial! Press Listen.

explore.label: Part 3 · the Newton’s cradle (Clue 4)

parts.label: ⚪ Pull, predict, let go
parts.title: 1, 2, then 3 balls
rows: Pick how many to pull back

explore.script:
Remember your Warm-Up prediction? Now you find out.

[ON SCREEN: Pull, predict, let go]
Pull back one ball, then two, then three. Predict first every time. Run three trials of each.

[ON SCREEN: The real thing]
Listen for the clicks. Why do you think it slowly stops? Press Listen.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: Whose prediction?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues. The envelopes open!

parts.label: 🪧 Make the sign
parts.title: Pick the speed limit
parts.body: Use the pattern to choose a speed nobody tested.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You have four clues. Crack the case at the top of this tab, and the envelopes open!

[ON SCREEN: Make the sign]
Then make the speed limit sign. Nobody tested that speed. Can your pattern predict it?

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Last, two short answers, your trial table and your CER. Press Listen.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “You should only run ONE trial. Running more is a waste of time.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The claim]
One trial and done? Hmm. Think about trial five on the flag lane. Think about Gus’s test.

There’s no wrong side, as long as you prove it.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts, then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…” Press Listen.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: ✉️ Your specimen
parts.title: An opened prediction envelope
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ⚪ Cradle free play
parts.title: How long is your streak?
parts.body: 5 or 7 balls. Predict, then let go.

parts.label: ➡ Next time
parts.title: Energy changes form
parts.body: Energy that turns from one kind into another.

closing.script:
(Open the envelope you held up at the start and read it.) My prediction: faster pushes farther. Supported!

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and the opened envelope goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Cradle free play]
Then try cradle free play. Tell me your best streak.

[ON SCREEN: Next time]
Next time: energy that changes from one form to another. Press Listen for Sam’s last word.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
